review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Pin the replacement Vertex model to global**

When `VERTEX_REGION` or `GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION` is set to a non-global location, choosing this replacement writes `vertex:gemini-3.1-pro-preview` without `config.region`, because the global-region branch below only recognizes `GEMINI_FLASH_MODELS`. `GoogleAuthManager.resolveRegion()` gives those environment variables priority over the model's entry in `VERTEX_GLOBAL_DEFAULT_MODELS`, so users whose configured location does not serve this preview get a failing generated target instead of the safe global endpoint; include this ID in the branch that emits `region: 'global'`.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
